exposure: Type of surgery: cesarean hysterectomy with internal iliac artery ligation (IIAL) vs uterine conservative-resective surgery
Within uterine conservative-resective surgery: IIAL vs identification-ligation of the upper vesical, upper vaginal, and uterine arteries
identification-ligation of the upper vesical, upper vaginal, and uterine arteries
cesarean hysterectomy with internal iliac artery ligation (IIAL)
cohort: 234 pregnant women diagnosed with PAS between 2013 and 2020 in a single tertiary hospital
finding: Uterine conservative-resective surgery, particularly with identification-ligation of specific arteries, was associated with lower blood loss and fewer complications compared to cesarean hysterectomy with IIAL in women with PAS.
